h1: MESHACK is a Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer based in Nairobi, Kenya.
h2: Not just code. Solutions. Systems where engineering meets people.
p: I work where clean software engineering meets thoughtful product design. Where complex architecture becomes an effortless user experience.

Based in Nairobi, Kenya, I specialize in architecting and building end-to-end web applications, distributed cloud APIs, and high-craft interactive interfaces for startups, teams, and ambitious digital products.
From full-stack SaaS platforms and real-time data pipelines to scalable APIs, cloud-native backends, and responsive frontend design systems, I engineer digital products that perform in real life.

I build products across fintech, SaaS, AI workflows, e-commerce, and developer tooling — working across TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, and modern cloud infrastructure.I don't just ship features. I architect resilient, maintainable systems from database schema to fluid UI motion.Because the strongest software isn’t just functional. It’s effortless to use.

From system design, REST/GraphQL APIs, and database optimization to responsive frontend architecture and CI/CD automation, I handle the complete product lifecycle from first commit to production.Based in Nairobi, Kenya — collaborating globally with founders, engineering teams, and product leaders.
